interface.name: init_patstat function
interface.signature:
def init_patstat() -> Tuple[PatstatClient, Session]: """ Initialize PATSTAT connection.
Returns: tuple: (PatstatClient, SQLAlchemy session) on success
Raises: ConnectionError: If PATSTAT is unavailable """ global patstat_client, db try: patstat_client = PatstatClient(env='PROD') db = patstat_client.orm() return patstat_client, db except Exception as e: raise ConnectionError(f"Could not connect to PATSTAT: {e}")
